$comment: Curated, CITED by-the-room legality for Charlottesville. This is the make-or-break legal field (CLAUDE.md golden rule #3). It is informational, NOT legal advice: every attach carries the stability_flag and a 'confirm per-parcel' caveat, and the engine marks by_room_legal confidence as 'modeled' (never 'real'/settled). Source: RESEARCH-FINDINGS.md Stream 4. The zoning-analyst subagent refines per-zone/per-parcel.
stability_flag: White v. City of Charlottesville: the 2024 Development Code was litigated, briefly VOIDED mid-2025, then SETTLED Oct 2025 and is back in effect. Confirm currency and pull a fresh per-parcel zoning determination before any high-bedroom deal.

default.str_note: Charlottesville restricts non-owner-occupied whole-house short-term rentals (homestay/transient-occupancy permit regime); modeled as NOT allowed by default. Informational, confirm per parcel.
default.note: The 2024 Development Code removed unrelated-occupant caps citywide (a July 2024 zoning determination approved a 9-10 bedroom dwelling as one 'household'). Applied as the citywide default; treat as 'modeled', confirm per parcel.

zones.$comment: Explicit per-zone entries (auditable + let a SQL join hit the zone row directly instead of the '*' fallback). The residential zones in the off-prime shortlist are seeded true; add a zone here as FALSE only when the zoning-analyst confirms it does not permit dwellings — do not guess.
